messages:
Elena: Quick heads-up 1: tomorrow's hybrid all-hands at 9:30am PT (SF HQ + Zoom). Short agenda below, please dump Qs into this thread or the doc. We'll record and post clips. Agenda:
1) Product: Dedicated capacity launch + SLA callouts (Marcus)
2) Reliability: incident playbook & fallback routing (Ravi)
3) People: parental leave + benefits changes (Jenna)
4) GTM: pilot customer update + migration package (Priya)
5) Live AMA with execs
6) Wrap & action owners

Logistics: join link https://zoom.redwood.example/ah, onsite room: Front Conf. Catering covered 1: add dietary needs here: https://forms.redwood.example/dietary. Recording will be posted within 24h; highlight clips within 48h.

Quick asks: prefix questions with [Q] and the agenda item number. Submit by 5pm today if you want prep. DM Jenna for private questions. 1: E

Marcus: I'll demo the Dedicated rollout (5min) and share latency/cost SLOs. Anyone want a specific metric called out?

Ravi: I'll summarise the updated postmortem cadence and new escalation steps. Playbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.example/playbooks/oncall. Note: fallback region routing goes live Monday 1: will outline mitigation windows.

Jenna: HR: parental leave extended to 18 weeks for primary caregivers; phased return options. Full policy: https://hr.redwood.example/leave. We'll do a 15-min Q&A during the meeting and office hours this week.

Priya: I'll present a customer snapshot and ask for input on migration assistance (we're proposing an initial 50-hour aid for pilots).

Elena: Please tag questions w/ agenda number. If private, DM me or Jenna.

Marcus: [Q][1] Are migration hours negotiable per customer? Short answer: yes, we'll baseline at 50 hours and scale per contract.

Ravi: [Q][2] Do P1 thresholds change? No, thresholds stay; notification routing and a secondary on-call tier added.

Jenna: Catering note 1: vegetarian + GF covered. Fill the form if you have allergies.

ops-bot: Recording queued. Transcript will be attached to the channel post. React with :clapper: for a team clip request.

Elena: Thanks everyone. Add items before EOD if needed. See you tomorrow.

Marcus: 1: thumbs up

Priya: Adding two customer slides now.
